QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Murt's Letter
QuestInfo.0: A ghost on the roof of the Lion King's tower asks that you listen to what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2161004# says he entered the castle in search of the Lion King's medal, but was cursed by the Lion King, which turned him into a ghost. He asks that you deliver his letter to Alcaster in El Nath.



#i4032859##t4032859# #b#c4032859##k/1
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 682,200
Can proceed to the Alcaster's Crystal quest
* Can purchase the #bVon Leon Set#k upon completion of the Alcaster's Crystal quest.

0.0: Please... If there is anyone who can hear my voice... Listen. Even if it's just for a moment... Listen to what I have to say...

yes.0: Can you hear me? Oh, what a relief! I was terrified that no one could hear me.
yes.1: My name is #b#p2161004##k. I came here looking for the legendary #bLion King's Medal#k. I was searching the entire castle for the medal, but then everything started shaking, and monsters appeared! I tried to run, when a man appeared in front of me out of nowhere.
yes.2: That man claimed that he was #bVon Leon the Lion King#k, the king of this castle. He then turned me into a ghost to trap me here...to punish me. It must be a curse or something. I can still feel my body...and it hurts a lot! I can't move much, and it even hurts to talk like this.
yes.3: I want to deliver this letter to my family. Could you take this letter to #bAlcaster#k in El Nath? Alcaster will then send it to my family.

no.0: Isn't there anyone who can hear me...?

1.0: Hm? A letter for me? From whom?

yes.0: Hm... So that's what happened to him. I warned him but he didn't listen. Tsk tsk...
yes.1: A few days ago, #p2161004# stopped by on his way to the castle, in search of the Lion King's Medal. I tried to stop him...I felt a strange energy from within the castle, but he didn't listen and entered the castle at night.
yes.2: I sent a rescue team to the castle, but the monsters that appeared scared them away.
yes.3: I'll deliver his letter to his family.

npc.0: Take this letter to Alcaster. I can trust him to deliver it to my family.

lost.0: You lost the letter? Unbelievable... Good thing I kept a copy, just in case! Here, take this.
